usage: The word '鋁' (leoi5) is used as a noun to refer to the metal aluminium.
'鋁' often appears in contexts related to materials or manufacturing.
When talking about objects made from aluminium, '鋁' is generally used before specifying the object type, e.g., 鋁罐 (aluminium can).
It can also be used figuratively to describe the material quality or characteristics related to aluminium.
'鋁' does not change form for plural or possessive contexts in Cantonese.
